data.exact_reserve_text: We are closing the 2019 account with a loss of GBP 8.6m being 4.0% of stamp, which is slightly below the midpoint of the range of estimates we last indicated. This was, on the whole, due to some deterioration in the Contingency account's COVID-19 claims, as changing lockdown restrictions caused some rescheduled events to be rescheduled again or even finally cancelled where further rescheduling was no longer practical.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 180.512m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year adverse development of approximately GBP 6.3m (c.3.5% of opening gross reserves), driven largely by deterioration in the 2019 underwriting year (notably contingency/COVID-19 related impacts) with mixed smaller movements in older years. Management attribute reserve deterioration on the 2019 closed year principally to COVID-19 related contingency claim activity and broader adverse claims development; named catastrophe events (Japanese typhoons) are referenced as drivers of JPY-denominated claims and currency shortfalls. The prior-year movement was derived from the report's gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: This was, on the whole, due to some deterioration in the Contingency account's COVID-19 claims, as changing lockdown restrictions caused some rescheduled events to be rescheduled again or even finally cancelled where further rescheduling was no longer practical.

In terms of COVID-19 claims, management have considered all policies exposed and potential coverages. The validity of each potential claims advice was assessed and any provision made on a case by case basis.
more catastrophe activity with perils such as floods, freezes and inland windstorms again causing headlines.
The currency shortfall in Japanese Yen is partly driven by the gross claims for Typhoons Hagibis, Faxai and Jebi being mainly in Japanese Yen but any recoveries being in US Dollars.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was not stated as a single gross figure in narrative; it was calculated from the report's gross claims development triangle (pages 44-45). No explicit 'movement in prior years' gross figure was provided. The 2019 closed-year commentary references COVID-19-related deterioration but does not quantify gross PYD. The computed PYD excludes the two most recent underwriting years per the methodology and may be impacted by RITC or other structural adjustments; confidence reflects a calculation from the published triangle (0.8).
